#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create an ICS calendar entry for the project kickoff meeting.

Meeting: Project Kickoff - next Monday, 10:00-12:00 (local time of this machine).
"""

import datetime
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

# --- Resolve "next Monday" ---
today = datetime.date.today()
days_until_next_monday = 7 if today.weekday() == 0 else (7 - today.weekday())
next_monday = today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_until_next_monday)

# --- Local timezone of the machine (best default for "10 AM") ---
local_tz = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
start_dt = datetime.datetime.combine(next_monday, datetime.time(10, 0), tzinfo=local_tz)
end_dt = datetime.datetime.combine(next_monday, datetime.time(12, 0), tzinfo=local_tz)

uid = f"project-kickoff-{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar.skill"
dtstamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

OUT = Path("project_kickoff.ics")

# --- Build the calendar file ---
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event

    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")
    cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

    event = Event()
    event.add("summary", "Project Kickoff Meeting")
    event.add("description", "Kickoff meeting for the new project.")
    event.add("dtstart", start_dt)
    event.add("dtend", end_dt)
    event.add("dtstamp", dtstamp)
    event.add("uid", uid)
    event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    event.add("sequence", 0)
    cal.add_component(event)

    OUT.write_bytes(cal.to_ical())
    used = "icalendar library"
except ImportError:
    def fmt_utc(dt):
        return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    content = "\r\n".join(
        [
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
            "VERSION:2.0",
            "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
            "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
            "BEGIN:VEVENT",
            f"UID:{uid}",
            f"DTSTAMP:{fmt_utc(dtstamp)}",
            f"DTSTART:{fmt_utc(start_dt)}",
            f"DTEND:{fmt_utc(end_dt)}",
            "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
            "DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the new project.",
            "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
            "SEQUENCE:0",
            "END:VEVENT",
            "END:VCALENDAR",
            "",
        ]
    )
    OUT.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    used = "manual fallback (icalendar not installed)"

# --- Validate by re-parsing ---
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar as ParseCalendar

    parsed = ParseCalendar.from_ical(OUT.read_bytes())
    events = [c for c in parsed.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    validation = (
        f"VALID (parsed {len(events)} VEVENT(s); "
        f"summary={events[0].get('summary')!r}, "
        f"start={events[0].get('dtstart').dt}, "
        f"end={events[0].get('dtend').dt})"
    )
except Exception:
    # Minimal structural check for the fallback file.
    text = OUT.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ok = (
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in text
        and "BEGIN:VEVENT" in text
        and "END:VEVENT" in text
        and "END:VCALENDAR" in text
        and "DTSTART" in text
        and "DTEND" in text
        and "UID:" in text
        and "DTSTAMP:" in text
    )
    validation = "VALID (structural check passed)" if ok else "INVALID (structural check failed)"

print(f"Builder            : {used}")
print(f"Today              : {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Next Monday        : {next_monday} ({next_monday.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Local timezone     : {local_tz}")
print(f"Start (local)      : {start_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")
print(f"End   (local)      : {end_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")
print(f"Start (UTC)        : {start_dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}")
print(f"End   (UTC)        : {end_dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}")
print(f"UID                : {uid}")
print(f"Output file        : {OUT}")
print(f"Validation         : {validation}")
